SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptrd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION, ftp.BASIS, ftp.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, ftp.VDATE, ftp.MDATE, ftp.TERM, ftp.TERM_TYPE, ftp.CALENDAR_ID, tpd.CCY, ftp.PRIN, ftp.M_INT_AMT, ftp.M_TRADE_AMT, ftp.INT_RATE * 100 rebackPrice,
ftp.ACT_CAP_DAYS, ftp.VPAY_DATE, ftp.MPAY_DATE,
tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, TPD.CHL_ID, TPD.FEE_AMT, TPD.TRADE_AMT, fpt.TYPE_6,
tpd.branch, tpd.regist_org
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptrd ON ptrd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp ON ( (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND ftp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID) OR (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03} AND ftp.FINPROD_ID = SUBSTRING(tpd.TRADE_ID, 0, LENGTH(tpd.TRADE_ID)-1)) ) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON ( (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND fpt.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID) OR (tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03} AND fpt.FINPROD_ID = SUBSTRING(tpd.TRADE_ID, 0, LENGTH(tpd.TRADE_ID)-1)) ) AND fpt.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT sum(IFNULL(INTOTALPRINAMT.AMOUNT, 0) * 100 * IFNULL(FSCR.SCALE, 0))- AVG(IFNULL(STANDARDPLEDGE.AMOUNT, 0)) PLEDGEPRINAMT FROM (SELECT PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.FINPROD_ID, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, PSP.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(PSP.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') CDATE, SUM(IFNULL(PSP.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON B.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE PSP.HODING_TYPE IN ('01', '03') AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND B.TRADE_PLACE in ( '03','04') AND PSP.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.FINPROD_ID, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, PSP.CCY, PSP.CDATE) AVA LEFT JOIN (SELECT TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, TPD.CCY, SUM(if(TPD.PS= 'T23', IFNULL(TPD.PRIN_AMT, 0) * -1, IFNULL(TPD.PRIN_AMT, 0))) AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPDA.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID WHERE FPT.TYPE_6 = 'H02' AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N' AND TPD.PS IN ('T23', 'T01') AND TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' AND TPD.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPD.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, TPD.CCY) STANDARDPLEDGE ON STANDARDPLEDGE.SEC_ACCT_ID = AVA.SEC_ACCT_ID AND STANDARDPLEDGE.PORTFOLIO_ID = AVA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND STANDARDPLEDGE.CCY = AVA.CCY LEFT JOIN (SELECT TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID, SUM(if(TSF.PS= '01', 1, if(TSF.PS='02', -1, 0)) * IFNULL(PSPF.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_STASEC_FLOW TSF LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL TSFD ON TSFD.SEQNO = TSF.SEQNO AND TSFD.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSPF ON TSF.SEQNO = PSPF.TRADE_ID AND PSPF.FINPROD_ID = tsfd.FINPROD_ID AND TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSPF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSPF.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND TSF.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID, TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID, TSFD.FINPROD_ID) INTOTALPRINAMT ON INTOTALPRINAMT.PORTFOLIO_ID = AVA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND INTOTALPRINAMT.SEC_ACCT_ID = AVA.SEC_ACCT_ID AND INTOTALPRINAMT.FINPROD_ID = AVA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCR ON FSCR.FINPROD_ID = AVA.FINPROD_ID AND FSCR.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCR.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO FSCRINNER WHERE FSCRINNER.FINPROD_ID = FSCR.FINPROD_ID AND FSCRINNER.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FSCRINNER.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND FSCRINNER.VDATE > FSCR.VDATE)

SELECT fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, fp.FINPROD_ABBR bondAbbrName, fp.MDATE mdate, mbvi.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, fp.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg, fpt.type_6 secType FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbvi ON mbvi.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbvi.VALUE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO mbviInner WHERE mbviInner.SEC_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND mbviInner.VALUE_DATE > mbvi.VALUE_DATE ) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON fp.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID where fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_ZQ} and fp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT SUM(qty) FROM ( SELECT fdt.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE qty FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_TARGET fdt on tpd.TRADE_ID = fdt.FINPROD_ID AND fdt.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO WHERE fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and tpd.finprod_type2 in ('F29') and STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= tpd.TRADE_DATE and STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= tpd.MDATE
union all
SELECT fdt.PLEDGE_NUMBER*100 qty FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdt on tpd.TRADE_ID = fdt.FINPROD_ID AND fdt.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO WHERE fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and tpd.finprod_type2 in ('F05') and STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= tpd.TRADE_DATE and STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') >= tpd.MDATE )

SELECT sum(IFNULL(ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_AMT, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_NUM)- IFNULL(ETR_FINISH_STATUS_A.FINISH_AMT, 0)) proAvailableCash FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST ON ETR_DISTRIBUTE.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ETR_FINISH_STATUS.ENTRUST_ID, sum(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) ETR_FINISH_STATUS_A ON ETR_FINISH_STATUS_A.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD ON ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID WHERE ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID IN
